summary: Seventh-iteration verification of the sync-growth + padding change on The Feeling Field. BACKEND: 12/12 pytest pass (added 3 new cases). GET /api/emotions returns exactly 169 emotions covering the full 13x13 grid (-6..6); (-5,+6) = 'TODO (-5,+6)' placeholder, (3,3) = 'Cheerful'; POST /api/emotions/generate {x:0,y:0} -> 200, source=curated, name='Neutral'. FRONTEND (Playwright, public URL, 1920x1080, in-page rAF sampling to avoid CDP throttling): PASS = final padding, smooth-decay shape, no-hover, detail-panel content, placeholder. FAIL/PARTIAL = the two things the user actually asked for. (1) PADDING AT REST/AFTER: rest edge-to-edge gap between bubble(0,0) and (1,0) is 10.00px (not ~5px as the spec assumed, because collide radius 27+4=31 => 62 < 64 grid step, so collision is inactive at rest). After selection the gap settles at 14.51px (>=12 required) and the selected .bubble-scale renders 81px wide (27*1.5*2) => PADDING GOAL MET at steady state. (2) SYNC: NOT achieved. Sampled every animation frame after click: CSS scale reaches 1.502 by t=432ms (as designed), but the center distance has only grown +5.14px of its final +18.54px push => only 28% of the neighbour displacement has happened when the visual growth is already complete. The push keeps creeping for ~2.5s (77% at 800ms, 93% at 1.2s, 98% at 2.0s, 100% at 2.55s). CONSEQUENCE: the edge gap DIPS to 1.58px at t=432ms (below the 10px rest gap) before recovering to 14.5px, i.e. the highlight visually crowds/overlaps its neighbours mid-animation - exactly the 'padding is inconsistent during the animation' complaint. (3) DESELECT: decay is smooth and near-monotonic (max change per 100ms = 2.41px, limit 5 => PASS) but at t=2000ms the distance is still +2.66px above baseline (spec tolerance +/-2px) and only reaches +0.42px at t=3000ms => marginal FAIL, same long-tail cause. (4) NO-HOVER: hovering (0,0), (3,-2), (-4,4) for 400ms each -> .bubble.is-hovered never in DOM, scale stays 1.000, neighbour delta <=0.41px. PASS. (5) DETAIL PANEL: detail-name='Cheerful', detail-description present, detail-coord and detail-source absent. PASS. (6) PLACEHOLDER: emotion-bubble--5-6 exists and opens 'TODO (-5,+6)'. PASS. Zero console errors, zero error elements.

ui_bugs.issue: Neighbour push is NOT in sync with the visual scale. Physics (d3-force ticks) completes only ~28% of the neighbour displacement by the time the 420ms CSS scale transition has finished, then keeps drifting for ~2.5s. The collision radius ramp is time-based but the resulting node displacement is tick/spring-based, so the two curves cannot match: forceX/forceY (strength 0.35) + velocityDecay 0.4 need dozens of ticks to reach the new equilibrium, and alpha(0.35) re-armed every frame with alphaDecay 0.04 / alphaMin 0.005 requires ~100+ ticks to settle after the ramp ends.

Padding between the selected bubble's highlight and its neighbours is NOT consistent during the animation: measured edge-to-edge gap goes 10.00px (rest) -> 1.58px (t=432ms, highlight nearly touching the neighbour) -> 14.51px (settled). The dip is caused by the visual radius reaching 40.5px well before the neighbours have been pushed out.

Return to baseline takes ~3s: distance is still +2.66px at t=2000ms (spec allowed +/-2px), +0.42px at t=3000ms. Same long alpha tail. Shape is smooth (max 2.41px per 100ms), so this is a duration issue, not a jump issue.

issues: Measured frame rate in this headless preview container is only ~8 fps even when idle, and disabling .bubble-aura/glow did not improve it (8.3 -> 9.2 fps), so the low fps is largely the GPU-less test container rather than the CSS. NOTE this amplifies the desync above (only 2-3 physics ticks land inside the 420ms window here). On a 60fps client the desync will be smaller but will NOT disappear, because the tail length is measured in ticks (~100 ticks to reach alphaMin), i.e. ~1.7s at 60fps.
Detail panel (bottom-left) still overlaps the bottom-left bubbles while open (pre-existing).

action_items: Make the neighbour push track the visual scale directly instead of relying on the spring to converge: drive the ramp from the simulation's own tick (or a manual solver) and force convergence each frame - e.g. rebuild collide ONCE with forceCollide(d => d.radius + 4).iterations(3).strength(1), and call simulation.tick() 2-4 times per rAF frame during the 420ms ramp so the layout reaches the new equilibrium within the ramp regardless of client fps.

Guarantee the gap never dips below the rest gap: lead the collision radius slightly ahead of the CSS scale (e.g. apply the SELECTED_PADDING immediately / ramp collision radius with a faster ease than the visual scale), so neighbours are already clear before the highlight reaches full size. Currently the gap collapses to 1.58px mid-animation.

Shorten the settle tail: raise alphaDecay/alphaMin (or drop alpha once the ramp is done) so the last 20% of the push/return doesn't creep for 1-2.5s. Deselect should be within +/-2px of baseline by 2000ms (currently +2.66px).

Avoid re-creating forceCollide and calling simulation.restart() on every rAF frame inside animateNodeRadius - re-initialising the force each frame is wasted work; set the force once and mutate node.radius only.
critical_code_review_comments: EmotionGrid.js animateNodeRadius(): re-registering force('collide', forceCollide(...)) plus .velocityDecay/.alphaDecay/.alphaMin/.alpha/.restart() on every animation frame re-initialises the force over all 169 nodes each frame and permanently re-arms alpha; this is both wasteful and the reason the motion has a multi-second tail.

Time-based radius ramp + spring-based positioning can never be 'in lockstep' - the eased radius is the input to a lagging second-order system. Either solve the collision to convergence each frame (multiple sim.tick() calls) or compute neighbour offsets analytically from the same easing curve used by the CSS transition.
Stale comment at EmotionGrid.js lines 194-197 still references scheduleShrink, which no longer exists.
Comment at line 140 still says the simulation exists 'only for hover physics' though hover was removed in iteration 3.

success_rate.frontend: 62% (5/8 checks fully pass; sync + mid-animation padding + 2s deselect tolerance fail)

seed_data_creation: No new data; POST /api/emotions/generate {0,0} returns a curated entry so nothing was written to Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use in-page requestAnimationFrame sampling (window.__sample pattern in this iteration) instead of page.evaluate polling: this container renders at only ~7-9 fps, so 60ms Playwright polling returns identical values 3x in a row and hides the animation. Always divide measured rects by the PanZoom scale (read DOMMatrix(getComputedStyle('.pz-surface').transform).a, currently 0.975 at fit) before comparing to logical px. Baseline logical values: grid step 64px, bubble diameter 54px, rest edge gap 10.00px, selected .bubble-scale width 81px, settled edge gap 14.51px, settled centre distance 82.5px (+18.54). Key numbers to re-check after the fix: (a) % of the +18.5px push completed at t=420-500ms (was 28%, target >=90%), (b) minimum edge gap during the growth animation (was 1.58px, must stay >= the 10px rest gap), (c) deselect delta at t=2000ms (was +2.66px, target <=2px). Backend regression suite /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now has 12 tests incl. exact-169 grid coverage, TODO placeholder at (-5,+6), 'Cheerful' at (3,3) and curated generate at origin.
rca_of_the_issue: The fix replaced an instant node.radius set with a time-based easeOutBack ramp, which correctly makes the collision RADIUS grow in step with the CSS scale, but the neighbours' POSITIONS are produced by the d3 force spring (forceX/forceY strength 0.35, velocityDecay 0.4/0.55) which lags the radius by many ticks. Result: at t=432ms the bubble is already at 1.5x (81px wide) while neighbours have moved only 5.14px of 18.54px, so the highlight-to-neighbour gap momentarily collapses from 10px to 1.58px before slowly opening to 14.51px over ~2.5s. Compounding factor: alpha(0.35) is re-armed every rAF frame and alphaDecay=0.04 / alphaMin=0.005 need ~100 ticks to decay, giving both grow and deselect a long creeping tail. The steady-state padding goal (SELECTED_PADDING=10 -> 14.5px gap) is met; only the temporal synchronisation is not.
